description: This file is a shell script (`.sh`) used for testing Git partial clone features, including functions for manipulating Git objects, running specific test scenarios, and validating behaviors related to partial clone fetches, object promises, and repository consistency.

methods.name: delete_object
methods.description: Removes a specific object from a Git repository by deleting the corresponding file in the objects directory.

methods.name: pack_as_from_promisor
methods.description: Creates a pack file from objects using Git's pack-objects command and marks it as a promisor.

methods.name: promise_and_delete
methods.description: Creates a promise tag for a given object and then deletes it from the object database.

methods.name: repack_and_check
methods.description: Re-pack the repository and verify the integrity of objects, ensuring promisor objects are properly handled.
